I fixed the wording in the Outline and closed `story-repo`#8. In the "Main finding" bullet, the exception to "the design and the estimator don't stack" is now stated as RMSE ratios to uniform × mean. Balanced × difference with λ = 1 is 0.75 against 0.81 for balanced × mean, a further 7% of RMSE. The MSE ratios, 0.56 and 0.66, are shown beside them. I also updated the page header, which still named the earlier Brief revision, to Brief rev 7.

I took the numbers from Brief rev 7 and did not check them against analysis's result files. I did not check whether paper-repo's text uses "MSE terms" for this pair.
